name: desire to improve
description: Wanting to get better in a particular way.

variations.name: improve health
variations.description: Engaging in physical exercise, study, or meditation toward improving your physical or mental health. For example, wanting to lose weight in order to feel more energetic.

variations.name: improve survival
variations.description: Spending time in physical exercise or study toward improving survival skills. For example, animals practice various skills that help them survive.

variations.name: improve social situation
variations.description: Engaging in physical exercise, study, or meditation toward improving a social relationship. For example, wanting to lose weight in order to be more attractive.

variations.name: improve existential self
variations.description: Engaging in physical exercise, study, meditation, or acts of kindness toward narrowing a perceived gap between your actual and ideal self.

conditions: Self perceives that spending time at something will improve health, social, or existential characteristics.
Self perceives that spending time at something will improve health or social characteristics.
